root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The routed file, relative to its root

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed, each under one fixed synthetic file name: `ts` (`.ts`, `.mts`, `.cts`, not a declaration file) as `vat.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `dts` (every name TypeScript's isDeclarationFileName accepts) as `vat.d.ts`, ScriptKind TS; `tsx` (`.tsx`) as `vat.tsx`, ScriptKind TSX; `js` (`.js`, `.jsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`) as `vat.js`, ScriptKind JS

ordinal.description: 0-based position among the file's module references, in source order

kind.description: The module reference: `import` an ImportDeclaration; `export` an ExportDeclaration with a module specifier; `importEquals` `import x = require('m')`; `dynamic` `import(...)`; `importType` a type-position `import('m')`; `require` a call whose callee is the identifier `require`, by spelling; `createRequire` a call `createRequire(...)('m')` or a call through a name a variable declarator anywhere in the file binds to a `createRequire(...)` result (the bare name, a local name a top-level import from `module` or `node:module` binds, or `X.createRequire`); `ambient` `declare module 'm'`; `referencePath`, `referenceTypes`, `referenceLib` a `/// <reference path|types|lib>` directive; `jsdocImport` a JSDoc `@import` tag (`js` only); `jsdocImportType` a JSDoc `import('m')` type (`js` only)

specifier.description: The text of the first argument or module specifier when it is a string literal or a template literal with no substitutions (for a call, seen through any parentheses around the argument), else null

specifierForm.description: `string` a string literal, `template` a template literal with no substitutions, or null when `specifier` is null

argumentCount.description: The call's argument count for `dynamic`, `require` and `createRequire`, else null

typeOnly.description: Statement level only: TypeScript's isExclusivelyTypeOnlyImportOrExport for `import` and `export`, isTypeOnly for `importEquals`; false for every other kind

hasClause.description: Whether the statement has an import or export clause

hasDefault.description: Whether the import clause binds a default import

hasNamespace.description: Whether the clause is a namespace import (`* as ns`) or a namespace export (`export * as ns from`)

namedBindings.description: The number of named elements, or null when there is no named clause

typeOnlyNamed.description: How many named elements carry an inline `type`, or null when there is no named clause

resolutionMode.description: The `resolution-mode` attribute through TypeScript's getResolutionModeOverride (on `import`/`export` attributes, an `importType`'s attributes, a `referenceTypes` directive), or null

attributeType.description: The `with { type }` attribute's value, or null

scope.description: `module` a top-level statement; `ambientModule` inside a `declare module` body; `nested` anywhere else

line.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break; at the specifier token's start (the opening quote or backtick), the argument's start when the specifier is null, the start of the value in the comment for a triple-slash directive

nodeLine.description: 1-based line, over the decoded text (BOM stripped); CR, LF and CRLF each one break; at the start of the node that carries the reference: the declaration for `import`, `export` and `ambient`, the external module reference for `importEquals`, the call for `dynamic`, `require` and `createRequire`, the import type node for `importType` (at its `import` keyword under a `typeof`, as ESTree places it), and `line` itself for triple-slash and JSDoc rows

package.description: For a bare specifier (one that starts with none of `.`, `/`, `#` or a `scheme:`): its first segment, or its first two when it starts with `@`; null otherwise, `node:` specifiers included. Always null for `referencePath`, `referenceTypes`, `referenceLib` and `ambient`, which declare or reference a module and do not import one by package (a `referenceTypes` name is not the package name: `node` resolves to `@types/node`)

builtin.description: Whether the specifier starts with `node:` or the running Node's isBuiltin (`node:module`) says it names a builtin; always false for `referencePath`, `referenceTypes`, `referenceLib` and `ambient`

lexicalTarget.description: A relative specifier folded against the file's directory (`.` and `..` segments only, no host), relative to the root; null otherwise. Set for `import`, `export`, `importEquals`, `dynamic`, `importType`, `require`, `createRequire`, `ambient`, `jsdocImport` and `jsdocImportType` when the specifier starts `.`, `..`, `./` or `../`; for `referencePath` set for any specifier that is not absolute (`globals.d.ts` is read as `./globals.d.ts`); always null for `referenceTypes` and `referenceLib`

projection-ts-imports.description: A row of the derived `ts_imports` relation
